membership.body:
Share proven Nx test results across PR scopes through the existing CI and release-plz jobs. Semantic manifest inputs mask coordinated release versions; text-reading checks retain raw inputs, and SDK/e2e version tests retain their versions. Cached outputs contain terminal output and named reports/profiles, without build directories or test binaries.

This is an implementation draft. Its own CI reports and the promotion/release-branch demonstration will be added before completion. The release shortcuts remain pending that evidence.

Local evidence:
- Real Nx over the recorded v0.13.2 → v0.13.3 edits: 108 of 120 cached task hashes unchanged. The 12 changed hashes are the five SDK/e2e version-reading test/coverage targets, SDK Python/TypeScript format and lint targets, and workspace format, lint and typecheck. The workspace typecheck reads Bun version lines as text.
- The matrix covers the original 110 cached tasks, checks original file-input coverage, mutates source, fixtures, dependencies, features and toolchains, and detects a deliberately removed input. Raw-formatting regressions drive the real Biome command and workspace guard. Both GitHub Projects targets now carry run/attempt nonces; the e2e target previously lacked them outside Linux’s derived session identity.
- The real Nx/pinned-sidecar cache and promotion journey passes with GitHub HTTP-doubled. Its simulated-release-selection cache-use result is 100% (2/2), through the production CLI under onebudgetspec. This is local journey evidence. The live demonstration figure is pending.
- Both recorded release-tail replays and the published-artifact path inventory pass. The first real cache-use release figure comes from the first published release after merge; the 100% design threshold is revisited from those observations.

Rust coverage remains uncached, with no profraw or object bytes stored, under manager ruling c-248a24202cf699ddf1bc0ff1f3f1b2c6. Coverage thresholds and measured scope are unchanged. The release coverage scheduling change and its per-target exceptions remain to be demonstrated.

Shared copies: remote cache and figures from dero-skills 63e071b72420bd6737226a50cb8a7a7760cc73a4; version-free inputs v3 from fe20052d06406bb07869c5236147b6693489d52f, each byte-checked. A later upstream cache-use reader fix is pending; the current copy stays unchanged until its amended landing pin arrives.

Local diff lint found and rechecked real findings. Two later focused judged invocations timed out without verdicts (20261104T060131Z-d4c81, 20261104T062438Z-4a48a); deterministic diff format/guard/static checks pass. Manager ruling c-03e6f299df6c1dfc5efdf3092f5e1f79 accepts that local evidence and leaves the whole-PR judged gate to CI.

+"""GitHub's HTTP boundary; Nx, the sidecar and production CLIs run unchanged."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import sys
+import threading
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
+from enum import Enum
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import NewType, TypeAlias
+from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse
+
+CacheKey = NewType("CacheKey", str)
+CacheVersion = NewType("CacheVersion", str)
+RefScope = NewType("RefScope", str)
+UploadToken = NewType("UploadToken", str)
+DownloadToken = NewType("DownloadToken", str)
+
+Json: TypeAlias = None | bool | int | float | str | list["Json"] | dict[str, "Json"]
+
+
+class Operation(str, Enum):
+    DOWNLOAD = "GetCacheEntryDownloadURL"
+    CREATE = "CreateCacheEntry"
+    FINALIZE = "FinalizeCacheEntryUpload"
+    DELETE = "DELETE"
+
+
+class StoreMode(Enum):
+    LIVE = "live"
+    FAULT = "fault"
+    THROTTLED = "throttled"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class EntryKey:
+    key: CacheKey
+    version: CacheVersion
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ScopedKey:
+    scope: RefScope
+    entry: EntryKey
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Call:
+    method: Operation
+    scope: RefScope
+    key: CacheKey
+    version: CacheVersion
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Upload:
+    scope: RefScope
+    entry: EntryKey
+    blocks: dict[str, bytes] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    body: bytes | None = None
+
+
+class GithubCache:
+    def __init__(self, directory: Path) -> None:
+        self.entries: dict[ScopedKey, bytes] = {}
+        self.uploads: dict[UploadToken, Upload] = {}
+        self.downloads: dict[DownloadToken, bytes] = {}
+        self.calls: list[Call] = []
+        self.mode = StoreMode.LIVE
+        owner = self
+
+        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+            def log_message(self, _format: str, *args: object) -> None:
+                pass
+
+            def reply(self, data: Json | bytes, status: int = 200) -> None:
+                body = data if isinstance(data, bytes) else json.dumps(data).encode()
+                self.send_response(status)
+                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
+                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream" if isinstance(data, bytes) else "application/json")
+                self.end_headers()
+                self.wfile.write(body)
+
+            def body(self) -> bytes:
+                size = self.headers.get("Content-Length", "")
+                if not size.isdecimal() or len(size) > 10 or int(size) > 128 * 1024 * 1024:
+                    raise ValueError("invalid Content-Length")
+                body = self.rfile.read(int(size))
+                if len(body) != int(size):
+                    raise ValueError("incomplete request body")
+                return body
+
+            def do_POST(self) -> None:
+                try:
+                    body = json.loads(self.body())
+                    if not isinstance(body, dict):
+                        raise ValueError("expected JSON object")
+                    if self.path == "/control":
+                        owner.mode = StoreMode(body.get("mode"))
+                        self.reply({"ok": True})
+                        return
+                    key, version = body.get("key"), body.get("version")
+                    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key or not isinstance(version, str) or not version:
+                        raise ValueError("cache key and version must be nonempty strings")
+                    scope = RefScope(self.headers.get("Authorization", "").removeprefix("Bearer "))
+                    if not scope.startswith("refs/"):
+                        raise ValueError("missing cache scope")
+                    entry = EntryKey(CacheKey(key), CacheVersion(version))
+                    method = Operation(self.path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])
+                    owner.calls.append(Call(method, scope, entry.key, entry.version))
+                    if owner.mode is StoreMode.FAULT:
+                        self.reply({"code": "internal", "msg": "store unavailable"}, 500)
+                        return
+                    match method:
+                        case Operation.DOWNLOAD:
+                            bases_file = directory / "bases.json"
+                            bases = json.loads(bases_file.read_text()) if bases_file.exists() else {}
+                            if not isinstance(bases, dict) or not all(isinstance(k, str) and isinstance(v, str) for k, v in bases.items()):
+                                raise ValueError("invalid fixture base scopes")
+                            found = next((owner.entries[ScopedKey(RefScope(s), entry)] for s in [scope, bases.get(scope, "refs/heads/main")] if ScopedKey(RefScope(s), entry) in owner.entries), None)
+                            if found is None:
+                                self.reply({"ok": False, "signedDownloadUrl": "", "matchedKey": ""})
+                            else:
+                                token = DownloadToken(str(len(owner.downloads)))
+                                owner.downloads[token] = found
+                                self.reply({"ok": True, "signedDownloadUrl": owner.url + "download/" + token, "matchedKey": key})
+                        case Operation.CREATE:
+                            if owner.mode is StoreMode.THROTTLED:
+                                self.reply({"code": "resource_exhausted", "msg": "rate limited"}, 429)
+                            else:
+                                token = UploadToken(str(len(owner.uploads)))
+                                owner.uploads[token] = Upload(scope, entry)
+                                self.reply({"ok": True, "signedUploadUrl": owner.url + "upload/" + token})
+                        case Operation.FINALIZE:
+                            uploads = [u for u in owner.uploads.values() if u.scope == scope and u.entry == entry]
+                            if not uploads or uploads[-1].body is None:
